caveats: Generation totals, provider subtotals and technology categories overlap. Electricity generation and sales differ in coverage and are not a direct estimate of grid losses. LECO is a separately reported electricity sales category. Other renewable energy groups wind, biomass, solar, dendro and municipal waste; the source says rooftop solar has been included in generation since 2018. Rounded components can differ slightly from totals. Fuel mass cannot be added to electricity output without energy conversion factors. These annual figures use a different reporting scope from the platform’s recent grid-generation feed.
The source uses .. for unavailable figures and a dash for nil or negligible. Both retain their printed token and a distinct status; neither is converted to an exact zero.
grain: One national annual energy measure and source category; totals overlap components
notes: National annual Ceylon Electricity Board and Ceylon Petroleum Corporation figures for 2021–2025, compiled by DCS. Electricity measures cover net generation by provider and technology and sales by customer category. Fuel measures cover imported refined petroleum, processed crude oil and LPG production.
